purpose: Inline static note or aside that highlights supporting commentary alongside body content without claiming live-region urgency.
useWhen: Drawing attention to tangential information nested inside prose, documentation, or article content.
Calling out a tip, note, or caveat that belongs next to the content it qualifies.
Explaining a state in a quiet neutral note that is not a problem, with one link or button at its end.

avoidWhen.reason: Announcing a transient or urgent status — use alert or banner instead.
Communicating a page-wide system message — use banner so it reads as a landmark region.
Wrapping a form control or an inline choice, such as a segmented-control — place it in the page flow with a plain label instead.
